# Workspace Instructions

- This workspace is a self-contained static web dashboard in `index.html`; preserve its no-build, no-dependency run path unless the project requirements change.
- Keep the visual language geotechnical and engineering-focused: deep navy, restrained cyan, explicit units, legible tables, and terrain/section diagrams.
- Keep calculations deterministic and expose assumptions. Do not invent trained-model predictions, metrics, labels, feature importance, or evaluation samples when model artifacts are absent.
- Treat all results as educational screening, not engineering design advice. Retain the 1.5 screening threshold and prominent project disclaimer.
- Validate browser interactions and responsive layout after changes; there is no Node.js toolchain in the current environment.
